title.en: 36th native american pow wow at traders village.
title.de: 36. native american pow wow im traders village.
title.tr: traders village'da 36. native american pow wow.

line.en: two days of intertribal dancing, drumming and native crafts. entry is free, parking is paid. check the hours before you go.
line.de: zwei tage intertribal tanz, trommeln und handwerk. der eintritt ist frei, das parken kostet. vorher die zeiten prüfen.
line.tr: iki gün intertribal dans, davul ve yerel el sanatları. giriş ücretsiz, park ücretli. gitmeden saatleri kontrol et.

sparks.why: 36th Native American Pow Wow at Traders Village Houston on 14 and 15 November, per a travel article (travelandtourworld.com); 2026 hours not confirmed, so no start time is given.
